title: Lootbox Session (Active Fairness Round)
description: Per-player active lootbox state: key balance, current commit-reveal seed pair, nonce. Persisted in lootbox_session table. One row per player_id. Source of truth for keys and fairness.

keys.description: Current key balance. Starts at STARTING_KEYS (25). Spent on crate opens, granted by gameplay.

server_seed.description: Server-side entropy for provably-fair rolls. Revealed only when retired.

server_seed_hash.description: SHA256(server_seed). Published up front so the server cannot change the seed without breaking the hash.

client_seed.description: Player-supplied entropy. Carries over on rotation.

nonce.description: Roll counter. Increments on every crate open. Used in HMAC input.

created_at.description: ISO 8601. When this seed pair was created.
